ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Sponsor sales, Meeting held and later stages need Sponsor objectives and Next step date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Sponsor_sales", CASE(StageName, "Prospect", 1, "Meeting held", 2, "Proposal sent", 3, "Negotiating", 4, "Contract out", 5, "Signed", 6, 0) >= 2, OR(ISBLANK(Sponsor_objectives__c), ISBLANK(Next_step_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Sponsor objectives and Next step date before moving to Meeting held.
